name: Lamb in Tomato Sauce with Rosemary White Bean Purée

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Season lamb with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 lamb loin chops
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add lamb and cook until browned, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash rosemary. Pick leaves off the stems. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg fresh rosemary
9 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Transfer lamb to a plate and return pan to stove. Add more oil and ½ of the rosemary and garlic (save the rest for the mash). Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
177 ml (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return lamb to pan and cook with the sauce until it is fully cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Heat a large saucepan over medium heat.
Grate 3 tsp of lemon zest. Drain and rinse beans; place on paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemon
3 (398 ml) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add lemon zest and remaining rosemary and garlic. Stir and cook for about 1 minute.
Add beans and broth. Cook until heated through, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 177 ml (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle with juice from the lemon and season with salt and pepper. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place lamb, tomato sauce, and bean mash on a plate. Enjoy!
